# Contributing 

Thanks for your interest!

All kinds of contributions are welcome, including bug reports, feature requests, and code contributions. Please read the following guidelines before contributing.

## Getting Started (PRs)

1. Fork the repository
2. Optionally create a new branch for your changes
3. Make your changes
4. Submit a pull request
5. Wait for review and feedback

## Licensing

By contributing to this project, you agree that:
- Your contributions will be licensed under thesame license as Slide.
- You retain copyright of your contributions
- You grant anyone using the project a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify, and distribute your contributions under the project license.

TLDR: Your contributions are licensed to Slide/Hackflare and its users, but you keep ownership of your work.
